method: Read saved sealed per-race scores; sum equal-race contributions without changing any mask, outcome, model or weight. This localizes score costs, not causes.
interpretation_limits: No observed cost establishes a causal gasoline effect or permission to exclude a race.
Every original race contribution retained; no posthoc replacement of primary all-race or competitive masks.
Numerical MCSE from original joint chains is separate from uncertainty across only two national elections per tier.
Identical source/training support within each fold prevents a gas-arm data-coverage advantage. AllA/B outcomes are exposed retrospective development evidence.
